ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS office_module_candidate (candidate_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,module_id VARCHAR(96) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,module_version VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),UNIQUE KEY uq_office_module_candidate_identity (module_id,module_version),CONSTRAINT chk_office_module_candidate_identity CHECK (module_id<>'' AND module_version<>'')) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS office_module_candidate_revision (candidate_revision_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,candidate_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,revision_no INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,manifest_sha256 BINARY(32) NOT NULL,manifest_bytes MEDIUMBLOB NOT NULL,claimed_artifact_set_digest BINARY(32) NOT NULL,claimed_signing_key_id VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),UNIQUE KEY uq_office_module_candidate_revision_no (candidate_id,revision_no),UNIQUE KEY uq_office_module_candidate_revision_identity (candidate_revision_id,candidate_id),KEY idx_office_module_candidate_revision_artifact (candidate_id,claimed_artifact_set_digest),CONSTRAINT fk_office_module_candidate_revision_candidate FOREIGN KEY (candidate_id) REFERENCES office_module_candidate(candidate_id),CONSTRAINT chk_office_module_candidate_revision_payload CHECK (revision_no>0 AND OCTET_LENGTH(manifest_sha256)=32 AND manifest_sha256=UNHEX(SHA2(manifest_bytes,256)) AND OCTET_LENGTH(manifest_bytes)>0 AND OCTET_LENGTH(manifest_bytes)<=16777215 AND OCTET_LENGTH(claimed_artifact_set_digest)=32 AND claimed_signing_key_id<>'')) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS office_module_candidate_evidence (candidate_evidence_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,candidate_revision_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,candidate_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,evidence_kind VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,evidence_sha256 BINARY(32) NOT NULL,evidence_bytes MEDIUMBLOB NOT NULL,created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),UNIQUE KEY uq_office_module_candidate_evidence_entry (candidate_revision_id,evidence_kind,evidence_sha256),KEY idx_office_module_candidate_evidence_revision (candidate_revision_id,evidence_kind,candidate_evidence_id),CONSTRAINT fk_office_module_candidate_evidence_revision FOREIGN KEY (candidate_revision_id,candidate_id) REFERENCES office_module_candidate_revision(candidate_revision_id,candidate_id),CONSTRAINT chk_office_module_candidate_evidence_payload CHECK (evidence_kind<>'' AND OCTET_LENGTH(evidence_sha256)=32 AND evidence_sha256=UNHEX(SHA2(evidence_bytes,256)) AND OCTET_LENGTH(evidence_bytes)>0 AND OCTET_LENGTH(evidence_bytes)<=16777215)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
